description: This file defines a mock class for the IGenericPlayerTaskFactory interface used in testing the media player tasks within the Rialto server component. It includes mock method declarations for creating various player tasks related to media handling, such as attaching samples, handling bus messages, and controlling playback.

classes.name: GenericPlayerTaskFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGenericPlayerTaskFactory interface for unit testing purposes, providing mocked methods to simulate creation of media player tasks.

methods.name: createAttachSamples
methods.description: Creates a mock task for attaching media samples to the player.

methods.name: createAttachSource
methods.description: Creates a mock task for attaching a media source to the player.

methods.name: createDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Creates a mock task for handling the event when a deep element is added to the pipeline.

methods.name: createEnoughData
methods.description: Creates a mock task indicating sufficient data is available.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a mock task for handling end-of-stream events.

methods.name: createFinishSetupSource
methods.description: Creates a mock task for completing source setup.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a mock task for handling bus messages.

methods.name: createNeedData
methods.description: Creates a mock task for requesting more data.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a mock task to pause playback.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a mock task to start or resume playback.

methods.name: createReadShmDataAndAttachSamples
methods.description: Creates a mock task for reading shared memory data and attaching samples.

methods.name: createRemoveSource
methods.description: Creates a mock task for removing a media source.

methods.name: createReportPosition
methods.description: Creates a mock task for reporting current playback position.

methods.name: createCheckAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Creates a mock task for checking audio underflow conditions.

methods.name: createSetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Creates a mock task for setting playback rate.

methods.name: createSetPosition
methods.description: Creates a mock task for setting playback position.

methods.name: createSetupElement
methods.description: Creates a mock task for setting up a GStreamer element.

methods.name: createSetupSource
methods.description: Creates a mock task for setting up a media source.

methods.name: createSetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Creates a mock task for setting video display geometry.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a mock task for adjusting volume.

methods.name: createSetMute
methods.description: Creates a mock task for muting or unmuting audio.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a mock task for shutting down the player.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a mock task to stop playback.

methods.name: createUnderflow
methods.description: Creates a mock task for handling underflow conditions.

methods.name: createUpdatePlaybackGroup
methods.description: Creates a mock task for updating the playback group.

methods.name: createRenderFrame
methods.description: Creates a mock task for rendering a frame.
